cand.title: Formation IA générative : Microsoft Copilot – Genève
cand.excerpt: Medium: full-day corporate training with breakfast and cocktail lunch; fixed venue.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Cassandra Attard, CCIFS Cheffe de projets événementiels, is the named edition contact and first operational qualification contact. Laureen Olivieri, CCIFS Responsable des activités événementielles et des adhésions, is relevant to future programme/venue relationships. Isabelle Neau, founder of Aixeleria and named trainer, is relevant to course delivery and potential future corporate workshops. None is publicly identified as holding hotel-contract signature authority.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced for 12 February 2027, 08:30–16:30 UTC+1, at LeBooster Genève, Route de Jussy 35, 1226 Thônex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. The dated programme confirms these are activity dates, within the requested horizon. Registration deadline: 8 February 2027 at 17:00. A separate Basel session is announced for 19 March 2027; it is not a replacement Geneva edition. No later Geneva Copilot edition through June 2028 was identified in the official material reviewed.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: weak fit for the committed 2027 edition. This is single-day Thônex training with catering programmed at LeBooster, not a verified residential meeting. Founex is outside the published event location. The edition promotes local access: “Léman Express : Gare de Chêne Bourg”, buses 32/37 and trams 12/17. No Geneva Airport-arrival or La Côte lodging evidence is published. YOTEL’s six flexible rooms could suit a separately commissioned La Côte corporate workshop, subject to headcount, technical requirements and unverified catering capacity. No basis exists for a 20–120-room block or whole-house demand. Resort positioning is not required by this format.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: “LeBooster Genève Route de Jussy 35, 1226 Thônex (Ge)”; access via Chemin de la Mousse, second floor. Territory: Geneva urban area, specifically Thônex municipality, not Geneva city proper and not Founex/Nyon/La Côte/Geneva Airport corridor. LeBooster is a CCIFS business centre, not a hotel. This is an announced venue commitment; signed contract terms are not public.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified Copilot courses: 26 June 2026 at LeBooster Genève, Thônex; 3 July 2026 at LeBooster Bâle, Basel. Announced courses: 12 February 2027 in Thônex and 19 March 2027 in Basel, again at the respective LeBooster centres. This establishes repeat delivery in two cities, not annual recurrence, a rotating congress or hotel rotation. The Geneva retrospective describes a historical “format volontairement restreint”.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No housing bureau, host hotel, edition-specific room block, accommodation booking link or open RFP is published on the reviewed Geneva edition page; no hotel is listed. Absence of published arrangements does not establish open sourcing or independent delegate booking. The published hospitality is catering: “La matinée débutera par un petit-déjeuner d’accueil et sera suivie, à midi, d’un cocktail déjeunatoire.” Programme: 08:30 coffee/croissant, 12:30 cocktail lunch, 16:30 finish. This quotation evidences catering only, not lodging arrangements. No attendance, peak-room or room-night figure is published.
findings.organizationStructure: CCIFS describes itself as an “association de droit local d’utilité publique, à vocation bilatérale”. It publishes the event and supplies the event contact. Aixeleria is the AI training provider; founder Isabelle Neau delivers the course. LeBooster is CCIFS’s business-centre/coworking platform. No external PCO, DMC or housing agency is identified in the reviewed edition material. Microsoft is the course subject/product; the page does not establish Microsoft as organizer or buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Incumbent meeting venue: organizer-linked LeBooster, not a hotel. Reuse in 2026 and 2027 and CCIFS’s own business-centre infrastructure are barriers to displacement; an organizer preference to retain the venue is an inference, not a published exclusivity condition. No overflow requirement, sold-out status, capacity shortfall or competing hotel block was found. Historical small-group wording cannot establish numerical 2027 attendance.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Cassandra Attard first, with Laureen Olivieri as programme-level contact. Acknowledge the existing 12 February LeBooster venue. Ask whether any delegates need independently sourced overnight accommodation and whether an external-venue La Côte corporate cohort is planned. If geographic and budget fit are confirmed, request an introduction to Isabelle Neau and propose a scoped day-meeting package, subject to verified headcount and YOTEL catering capability. Do not quote a room block or claim an RFP before receiving a confirmed brief.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low venue/catering accessibility: 12 February 2027 is advertised at LeBooster with coffee and lunch programmed. Delegate registration is not a supplier opportunity. Accommodation sourcing remains unknown, not open; no lodging commitment elsewhere is evidenced either. Do not qualify a current room-block opportunity without organizer confirmation of traveling delegates and independently addressable lodging.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship opportunity only. Repeat courses justify asking about additional cohorts but establish neither an annual cycle nor a tender. Seek an incremental La Côte/Nyon employer-funded workshop rather than presume relocation of the Thônex course. The separate 19 March 2027 Basel session is outside YOTEL’s territory and provides no Geneva-airport/La Côte travel evidence. No later Geneva date or open venue-sourcing process was identified.
